description: How findings from named Tier 2 procedures are classed and grouped. Classification never changes whether a procedure counts as performed or raised an issue (completion is unchanged); it changes how a finding is rated and presented. Decisions follow an independent review of the ESO licence model report (2026-10-19) and were recorded on Mik Riazanov's go-ahead.

sameRemediationGroups.label: Version and change control
sameRemediationGroups.note: One version and change-control record answers all of these; they are grouped as one repair and one retest.

governanceImprovement.note: Rated as a governance improvement (P3) for a regulated-network model: release, version and issue governance is normally kept in a controlled record outside the workbook, and the workbook's own check rows count as controls. The absence is real; it is not evidence of a calculation error.

designPreference.note: Recorded as an observation for a regulated-network model: the scenario table is a vector of selectable parameters with spare columns, so a combined or rate-shock case can be configured without a structural change. No failure of a required method is shown.
